bridge-type.label: myVAILLANT Account
bridge-type.description: The account of the myVAILLANT app

parameter-group.name: update
parameter-group.label: Updates
parameter-group.description: Vaillant limits the number of requests per account (call volume quota). Every update of a system costs 2 requests plus one for each optional value below.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Email address of the myVAILLANT account

parameter.name: country
parameter.label: Country
parameter.description: Country the account is registered in (required for Vaillant and Saunier Duval), e.g. germany, austria, unitedkingdom, czechrepublic

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Seconds between updates of the systems

parameter.name: energyRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Energy Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Minutes between updates of today's energy values, 0 disables them. Only linked energy channels are updated, each costs one request.

parameter.name: fetchRts
parameter.label: Fetch Operation Time and Cycles
parameter.description: Updates operation time and on/off cycles of the devices (RTS, one request per update)

parameter.name: fetchMpc
parameter.label: Fetch Current Power
parameter.description: Updates the current power of the devices (MPC, one request per update)

parameter.name: fetchConnectionStatus
parameter.label: Fetch Connection Status
parameter.description: Updates whether the system is connected (one request per update)

parameter.name: fetchTroubleCodes
parameter.label: Fetch Trouble Codes
parameter.description: Updates the diagnostic trouble codes (one request per update)

parameter.name: refreshDelay
parameter.label: Refresh Delay
parameter.description: Seconds to wait after a command before updating, the API takes a while to return new values

parameter.name: quickVetoDuration
parameter.label: Quick Veto Duration
parameter.description: Hours a temperature set outside of manual mode (quick veto) lasts

parameter.name: holidayDuration
parameter.label: Holiday Duration
parameter.description: Days away mode lasts when switched on without an end

parameter.name: manualCoolingDuration
parameter.label: Manual Cooling Duration
parameter.description: Days manual cooling lasts when switched on without an end
